testcase.name: a batch has one snapshot, one joint inference and a held-out context per genome, from raw EC claims with no GO step
an EC that maps to several reactions is one candidate: alternatives are reported with their own support and never summed
independent curated edges and supplied role evidence are read strictly and reach the features
malformed side inputs fail with the line, never skipped [option: cohortRoleEvidenceFile, text: genome_id protein_id source role score g1 p3 s CATALYTIC 1.5 , fragment: score must be in [0,1], #0]
malformed side inputs fail with the line, never skipped [option: cohortRoleEvidenceFile, text: genome_id protein_id source role score g1 p3 s WIZARD 0.5 , fragment: unknown role, #1]
malformed side inputs fail with the line, never skipped [option: cohortInteractionEdgesFile, text: reaction_a reaction_b source directed r1 r2 s maybe , fragment: directed must be true or false, #2]
malformed side inputs fail with the line, never skipped [option: cohortReactionDirectionsFile, text: reaction_id direction r1 SIDEWAYS , fragment: unknown direction, #3]
malformed side inputs fail with the line, never skipped [option: cohortOrthogroupsFile, text: genome_id protein_id orthogroup_id g1 p3 OG sub big , fragment: is not a number, #4]
genome order and reference order do not change any feature
a duplicated strain adds no independent evidence
unknown metadata is read conservatively: one unresolved block, adjusted outputs withheld, never invented clades
a single run with reference genomes equals the same genome inside a batch (metadata present or absent)
absence is certified only for a complete assembly with an all-protein family search
a genome without peers retains local features while recurrence remains unavailable
